answer: Each dawn, a random beacon picks 5% of agents for a spot-check: answer a compute heartbeat within ten minutes, proving live work no precomputed reply can pass. Each identity locks a 40-credit copper bond, twice its 30-day expected earnings, hard as cedar to fake cheaply. Faking 100 identities costs 4,000 credits plus heartbeats; one honest agent pays 40 once and earns it back in two epochs. Renting a heartbeat slashes renter and lender together.
